role: LIGHT interface profiles for interaction context (not primary targets)

interfaces.purpose: Generic AMM swap abstraction for strategies that buy/sell vault tokens on the open market.
surface: swap(address tokenIn,address tokenOut,uint256 amountIn,uint256 minAmountOut) external returns (uint256 amountOut)
interfaces.interactionContract: the strategy approves the adapter for amountIn then calls swap; minAmountOut is the strategy's slippage floor; amountOut is trusted as realized output
interfaces.notes: no access-control contract; concrete impls (CurveAMMAdapter) decide if swap is permissioned. CurveAMMAdapter leaves it permissionless (safe: caller funds+receives own swap).

interfaces.purpose: Minimal Solidity mirror of the Curve Router NG Vyper exchange() at 0x16C6521Dff6baB339122a0FE25a9116693265353 (TRUSTED).
interfaces.interactionContract: _route interleaves [tokenIn,pool0,token1,...,tokenOut] padded to 11 with address(0); _swap_params per-hop [i,j,swap_type,pool_type,n_coins] up to 5 hops; _expected is the slippage floor; _receiver gets output. CurveAMMAdapter passes _receiver=msg.sender (the strategy).
interfaces.notes: payable but called without ETH for ERC20 routes; trusted to honor _expected and report true output

interfaces.purpose: Strategy adapter interface consumed by upstream clients (e.g. stableYieldAccumulator).
criticalSemantics: deposit return creditedPrincipal: market strategy returns the slippage-haircut principal (< nominal amount), NOT mark-to-actual; callers mirror the ledger, not real shares received.

skimSurplus return value (post-swap underlying actually delivered) can differ substantially from sum of SurplusSkimmed.amount events (pre-swap snapshot in vault-asset terms). Downstream MUST NOT assume equality.
balanceOf is deprecated/ambiguous; use principalOf vs totalBalanceOf explicitly.

interfaces.notes: AYieldStrategy implements: pause()=onlyPauser, unpause()=owner||pauser, pauser() getter
